livenessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: liveness-port
  failureThreshold: 1
  periodSeconds: 10
```

The `failureThreshold` is set to 1, meaning the container will be restarted after one failed probe. The `periodSeconds` is set to 10, indicating the probe runs every 10 seconds. This setup helps in quickly detecting and responding to application deadlocks by restarting the container if the probe fails.",
